question: Should this release remove the listed root bundled skills and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin, with a doctor migration for shipped references?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes shipped skill availability, upgrade behavior, official install trust, dependency graph contents, and native artifact handling, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Land with migration and trust approval
options.body: Add and prove the doctor upgrade path, authorize the exact dependency graph, and approve Sherpa package and artifact provenance before merging.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Land a narrower Sherpa externalization after trust approval while retaining the current bundled starter set until its migration plan is ready.

options.title: Park the broad trim
options.body: Keep current bundled availability and pause or close this branch until a release-owned deprecation contract exists.

recommendation.title: Land with migration and trust approval
recommendation.body: Add and prove the doctor upgrade path, authorize the exact dependency graph, and approve Sherpa package and artifact provenance before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the two merged split changes, is assigned here, and defined the remaining decision surface in the discussion.
